ticket.title: VPN connection fails after password reset
ticket.description: I reset my corporate password this morning. Since then, the VPN client connects briefly and then disconnects. I restarted the laptop and reinstalled the VPN client, but the issue persists. I need access to the internal systems for today's work.
ticket.representation:
